title: Fjordheim
tagline: A Viking family's first year by the fjord
description: An isometric homestead builder, inspired by Anno 1404 and The Settlers, without any fighting. A family lands on an empty shore in Viking Age Scandinavia: choose what to build (a longhouse, a woodcutter, a fishing hut, barley fields, a sawpit, a storehouse, a well, a smithy) and they do the work themselves; pause a workplace when its goods are needed elsewhere, or tear it down. Keep them fed and warm through the first winter, and leave the forest standing: the deer leave if you cut it too thin.
controls: B or BUILD, then a building (or 1-9)
build it there (right click / Esc cancels)
phone: tap the map, then tap again
see where it goes, then build it
pause its work, or tear it down (half the cost back)

dayLength.label: Day length
dayLength.help: Seconds from one dawn to the next. The family eats every morning, so shorter days make it harder.

daysPerSeason.label: Days per season
daysPerSeason.help: Four seasons make a year; reach the second spring to win. More days: more time before winter, and a longer winter.

startFood.label: Food on the ship
startFood.help: What the family brings ashore. Three of them eat 2.5 a day.

harvest.label: Barley harvest
harvest.help: Food from reaping one ripe field.

walk.label: Walking speed
walk.help: How fast everyone walks (a tile is about 4 m).

deerForest.label: Forest the deer need
deerForest.help: The share of the first forest that must stand, grown, for the deer to stay. A woodcutter plants a tree for every two he fells, and saplings take three days to grow: two woodcutters all year thin it to about this.

edgeScroll.label: Scroll at the screen edge
edgeScroll.help: Move the view when the mouse touches the edge of the game.
